sn53.1-12:1.5: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajam pītisukhaṃ pathamam jhānam upasampajja viharati || || 4.
sn53.1-12:1.6: Vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvam avitakkam avicāraṃ samādhijam pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharati || || 5.
sn53.1-12:1.7: Pītiyā ca virāgā upekhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti || Yan tam ariyā ācikkhanti upekhako satimā sukhavihārī ti tatiyaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharati || || 6.
sn53.1-12:1.8: Sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānam atthagamā adukkham asukham upekhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharati || || 7.
sn53.1-12:1.9: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro jhānā ti || || 8.
sn53.1-12:2.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave Gaṅgā nadī pācīnaninnā pācīnapoṇā pācīnapabbhārā ||
sn53.1-12:2.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu cattāro jhāne bhāvento cattāro jhāne bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro || ||
sn53.1-12:2.3: Kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu cattāro jhāne bhāvento- -nibbānapabbhāro || || 9.
sn53.1-12:2.4: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkasavicāram vivekajam pītisukham pathamaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharati ||
sn53.1-12:2.8: Evam kho bhikkhave bhikkhu cattāro jhāne bhāvento cattāro jhāne bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro ti || || Jhānasaññuttassa pathamasuddhiyam suttantaṃ || || Yad api satipaṭṭhānaṃ tad
sn53.1-12:3.4: vaggo tena pavuccati || || Jhānasaṃyuttassa Gaṅgāpeyyāli pathamo || ||
